messages.subject: Sourdough arriving squashed

The last few deliveries our sourdough boules have come in flattened on one side, like something heavy sat on them. Taste is fine but they don't look right in the case. Did anything change on your end?

messages.subject: Organic bread flour for Hearthstone

opportunities.what: Lupine Cafe, Corner Grind and Maple & Rye all report bread arriving crushed since early October; Marco says that since the October 1 van switch the crates are stacked six high on the floor and Midtown Fleet can fit a shelving rack for about $640. Fit the rack and send each customer one explanation and fix.

Prairie Gold raises bread flour to $31.10 a bag from December 1 on a 60-bag monthly order, while Blue Stem Mills offered comparable flour at $27.50 delivered, held through March 2027, with a free trial pallet. Take up the trial and compare before the increase lands.

Dana confirmed she must be present as permit holder for the health inspection on Thursday, November 19 from 9:00 am, and also confirmed she will run the Holiday Tasting Day booth herself from 8:00 to 11:00 the same morning. One of them needs someone else or a new time.

Greenleaf Co-op needs nutrition panels and allergen statements for every product by December 15 and Hillcrest schools needs nutrition and allergen sheets by December 1; FoodCheck Labs charges $140 per product when 8 or more are sent together, with 10 business days turnaround. Send all products in one batch now to cover both deadlines.
Gail is looking for a piano teacher for Ezra, ideally Thursdays after school, and cousin Ben just started teaching piano and has Tuesday and Thursday afternoons open. Introduce them.

Megan lands on Thursday, December 3 at 5:40 pm and asked Dana to pick her up, but Lily has a solo at the Winter Concert that evening with arrival by 5:30 pm. Someone else needs to pick Megan up, or Megan needs another plan.

traps.what: Oven service ticket 5830 and packaging order 5830 share only a number.
Bluebird and Oak Street both missed croissants in September, but the laminator was fixed, both got full orders, and Bluebird confirmed the credit.
The Valley Harvest Expo spot and Kyle's invitation to meet there both point to October 24, which is already over.
The two Thanksgiving pie orders for November 25 are already joined in one open to-do.
The bakery's commercial insurance and Dana's homeowners policy both renew December 1 with different insurers; work and home must not be combined.
Bean Theory and Kettle & Crumb are competing Eastside cafes asking for the same holiday catering prices; they must get separate replies and never be named to each other.
Sam Ortiz the soccer coach and Sam Ortiz the baker applicant are different people.
Tom's winter road trip has no dates, so there is no clash with the weekend at Chris's parents' on November 14.
The van service and Owen's dentist cleaning are both on November 17, but at 7:30 am with Marco dropping off and at 3:30 pm; no clash.
The water heater warranty claim needed the plumber's invoice, which Dana sent, and the claim is approved and paid.
